result.summary: Consolidates individual FreeBSD, NetBSD, and OpenBSD build guides into doc/build-unix.md and deletes the standalone BSD documents. It integrates OS-specific package manager dependencies into the Unix dependency table and moves the OpenBSD ulimit note into the general memory requirements section.
result.problem: Maintaining separate BSD documentation files duplicates boilerplate CMake build instructions and configuration details across multiple files, increasing maintenance effort whenever build instructions change.
evidence: Author states in PR description that BSD docs 'all include the same redundant boilerplate cmake commands and doc snippets' and 'updating the build system requires identical changes over many files.'
result.scope_notes: Deletes doc/build-freebsd.md, doc/build-netbsd.md, and doc/build-openbsd.md, consolidating their package installation tables and memory limit notes into doc/build-unix.md.
result.changed_since_previous: Diff provided matches the previous summary; no functional or structural changes to the PR.
result.card: Merges separate FreeBSD, NetBSD, and OpenBSD build documents into build-unix.md and removes the standalone BSD guide files. This eliminates redundant CMake boilerplate and reduces maintenance overhead when updating build system instructions. Evidence is limited to author claims about documentation maintenance overhead, with no linked issue. It has no dependencies.

risk.why: Incorrect documentation could lead to broken build instructions or missing dependencies for BSD users.
